correctness.rationale: For every nonsingular real A and residual r with r,Ar independent, the TGA(1;1,0) prolongation spans exactly span{r,Ar}; its presmoothed affine space is therefore identical to the length-two Krylov affine space. Positive definiteness of P^T A^T A P provides a unique least-squares correction. Expansion gives det(G)=omega^6(uw-v^2), trace(G)=omega^2(2u-2omega v+omega^2 w); the scalar trace/sqrt(det) is sqrt(kappa)+1/sqrt(kappa) and has an exact nonnegative completed-square penalty w(omega-omega_star)^2/(omega sqrt(Delta)). This proves uniqueness, equality condition, and omega^-2/omega^2 asymptotics. The decoded standalone checker performs 1,242 assertions on 23 explicit 3x3 matrices; no finite experiment is treated as universal proof.

value.rationale: The originating 2026 method is defined by a presmoother plus a current and presmoothed residual coarse basis, with depth one showing nontrivial performance differences. For this natural scalar-Richardson regime the theorem separates exact mathematical iteration effect (provably no weight dependence) from coarse normal-matrix conditioning (a unique, explicitly calibratable optimum, perfect-conditioning criterion, exact quadratic penalty and unbounded endpoint degradation). The sharp optimum can even leave the stand-alone Richardson stability interval without changing the final cycle, as a 3x3 SPD example demonstrates. These facts are useful for method comparison and parameter choice, rather than a rebranding of an arbitrary statistic. No wall-clock or arithmetic-error guarantee is claimed.
